title: IntelliRAG
summary: AI-powered research assistant for document Q&A and web-based knowledge retrieval, with local RAG and multi-model support.
highlights: Built a local RAG system for document question answering
Integrated Gemma 3 for conversational AI and Llama 3.2 for document analysis
Added real-time web access through the Tavily API to augment answers with current information
body:
## Overview

IntelliRAG is a local AI-powered research assistant designed for document question answering and web-based knowledge retrieval.

## Architecture

The system combines local retrieval with multiple language models. Documents can be analyzed using Llama 3.2, while Gemma 3 handles conversational interactions. Tavily provides web access when information beyond the local document collection is required.

## What I built

The project brings together document retrieval, conversational AI, and real-time web knowledge into a single research workflow, with the goal of making information retrieval more useful without relying entirely on cloud-hosted models.

title: DevConnect
summary: Community-driven developer collaboration platform built around real-time interaction and technology-based discovery.

cover.alt: Developers collaborating on a software project

highlights: Built a MERN-based platform for developer collaboration
Integrated a Hugging Face NSFW detection model for platform safety
Designed developer discovery around technology stack preferences
body:
## Overview

DevConnect is a community-driven developer collaboration platform designed to help developers connect and collaborate based on their technology interests.

## Features

The platform uses React.js on the frontend with an Express.js backend and MongoDB for persistent data. Socket.IO provides real-time functionality, while a Hugging Face NSFW detection model adds an automated safety layer.

## Focus

The project combines full-stack development, real-time communication, machine learning integration, and community-focused product design.

title: LogicLink
summary: Multipurpose Discord bot combining moderation, music playback, and community utilities into a single platform.

cover.alt: Discord bot and community automation concept

highlights: Automated moderation, music playback, and community engagement features
Consolidated multiple bot responsibilities into one system
Implemented persistent user and server data storage using SQLite
body:
## Overview

LogicLink is a multipurpose Discord bot designed to consolidate common community management and entertainment features into a single system.

## Features

The bot provides automated moderation, music playback, and community engagement functionality. Discord.py handles the Discord integration, while Wavelink provides music functionality.

## Persistence

SQLite provides persistent storage for user and server data, allowing the bot to maintain configuration and state across sessions.
